text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was training with Mejiro Ryan, but her 
movements lacked their usual sharpness.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm totally fine! Just look at these 
dynamic, thriving muscles—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh...? My biceps aren't as pumped 
as usual.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Your hamstrings and triceps surae lack 
energy entirely!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her muscle tone doesn't seem quite right 
either. Perhaps fatigue is catching up 
with her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should reconsider our upcoming 
race schedule...
